correctness.rationale: Square-class quotient U_N/U_N² enumerates all real nonprincipal characters, primitive and imprimitive. Bernoulli polynomial identities express B1,B3,B5 exactly in integer power sums; even-parity polynomials have roots ±i, odd parity reduces to reciprocal quadratic with root-on-circle iff 5B3²<=3B1B5. Independent exact enumeration for every 2<=N<=163 found 433 characters (173 even, 260 odd; 85 odd B1=0), sole ratio>1 at N=163 and unique maximum under 163 at N=67. This is exhaustive within the FINITE stated range, not a theorem for larger moduli.
